## Read in datasets and count the tumor transgene markers
```{r transgene_read}
#| dependson: [scanbit_prep_mouse_gfp_rfp]
transgene_samples <-
    read_tsv(
        "misc/validation_geo_metadata.tsv",
        show_col_types = FALSE
    ) %>%
    filter(sample_group == "truthset validation") %>%
    pull(Sample_ID) %>%
    unique()

roberts_transgene_samples <-
    read_tsv(
        "misc/mouse_samples_Roberts_realign_metadata.tsv",
        show_col_types = FALSE
    ) %>%
    pull(Sample_ID)

transgene_samples <- c(transgene_samples, roberts_transgene_samples)

sobj_list <- list()
for (this_sample in transgene_samples) {
    sobj_list[[this_sample]] <-
        qs::qread(paste0(
            "output/seurat_objects/individual/",
            this_sample,
            "_mouse.qs"
        )) %>%
        PercentageFeatureSet(pattern = "^tumor", col.name = "tumor_marker_pct")

    sobj_list[[this_sample]]$cell_group <- paste0(
        sobj_list[[this_sample]]$cluster_label,
        "_c",
        sobj_list[[this_sample]]$individ_clusters
    )

    for (this_cutoff in c(5, 10, 20, 30)) {
        sobj_list[[this_sample]] <- add_snv_group_to_sobj(
            sobj_list[[this_sample]],
            snv_group_file = paste0(
                "output/snv/transgene/snvs_",
                this_sample,
                "_",
                this_cutoff,
                "_groups.txt"
            ),
            new_columns = paste0(
                c("snv_group_", "snv_top_lvl_group_"),
                this_cutoff
            ),
            cell_group = "cell_group"
        )
    }

    tumor_markers <-
        grep(
            "^tumor",
            rownames(sobj_list[[this_sample]]),
            value = TRUE
        )

    if (length(tumor_markers) > 0) {
        sobj_list[[this_sample]]$tumor_marker_count <-
            FetchData(
                sobj_list[[this_sample]],
                vars = tumor_markers,
                layer = "counts"
            ) %>%
            rowSums()

        sobj_list[[this_sample]]$tumor_cell <-
            if_else(
                sobj_list[[this_sample]]$tumor_marker_count > 0,
                TRUE,
                FALSE
            )

        this_plot <-
            ((
                DimPlot(
                    sobj_list[[this_sample]],
                    group.by = c("cell_group"),
                    pt.size = 1.5,
                    label = TRUE,
                    label.box = TRUE,
                    repel = TRUE
                ) +
                    NoLegend() +
                    coord_fixed()
            ) +
                (
                    DimPlot(
                        sobj_list[[this_sample]],
                        group.by = c("tumor_cell"),
                        pt.size = 1.5,
                        label = TRUE,
                        label.box = TRUE,
                        repel = TRUE
                    ) +
                        NoLegend() +
                        coord_fixed()
                )) /
                ((
                    DimPlot(
                        sobj_list[[this_sample]],
                        group.by = c("snv_top_lvl_group_10"),
                        pt.size = 1.5,
                        label = TRUE,
                        label.box = TRUE,
                        repel = TRUE
                    ) +
                        NoLegend() +
                        coord_fixed()
                ) +
                (
                    FeaturePlot(
                        sobj_list[[this_sample]],
                        features = "tumor_marker_count",
                        order = TRUE,
                        pt.size = 1.5
                    ) +
                        coord_fixed()
                ))

        ggsave(
            paste0("output/figures/transgene/", this_sample, "_plots.pdf"),
            plot = this_plot,
            width = 15,
            height = 15
        )
    } else {
        sobj_list[[this_sample]] <- NULL
    }
}

merge(sobj_list[[1]], sobj_list[-1])@meta.data %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    select(Sample_ID, tumor_cell, individ_clusters, cluster_label) %>%
    mutate(
        cell_group =
            paste0(
                cluster_label,
                "_c",
                individ_clusters
            )
    ) %>%
    select(-individ_clusters, cluster_label) %>%
    group_by(Sample_ID, cell_group, tumor_cell) %>%
    summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Sample_ID, cell_group) %>%
    mutate(proportion = n / sum(n)) %>%
    filter(tumor_cell == TRUE) %>%
    arrange(desc(proportion)) %>%
    write_tsv("output/snv_processing/transgene/transgene_tumor_clust.txt")


VlnPlot(sobj_list[["G0010"]], features = c("tumor_marker_pct", "tumor_marker_count"))
DimPlot(sobj_list[["G0016"]], group.by = "tumor_cell")
```

## Look at lineage tracing barcodes

```{r transgene_ltbc}
ltbc_samples <- c("S0261", "S0262")

for (this_sample in ltbc_samples) {
    sobj <-
        qs::qread(paste0(
            "output/seurat_objects/individual/",
            this_sample,
            "_mouse.qs"
        ))

    ltbc_table <- gen_cellecta_bc_data(
        paste0(
            "/home/gdrobertslab/lab/Counts_2/",
            this_sample,
            "/possorted_genome_bam.bam"
        ),
        samtools_module = "GCC/9.3.0 SAMtools/1.10", verbose = TRUE
    )

    ltbc_sub <-
        ltbc_table %>%
        mutate(
            cid = paste0(cid, "-1"),
            barcode = paste0(lt_14, "_", lt_30),
            has_barcode = TRUE
        ) %>%
        select(-lt_14, -lt_30) %>%
        group_by(cid) %>%
        slice_head(n = 1) %>%
        column_to_rownames("cid")

    sobj <-
        AddMetaData(
            stuff,
            ltbc_sub
        )

    # replace data missing from ltbc_table with values

    sobj$tumor_marker_count <-
        FetchData(
            sobj,
            vars = tumor_markers,
            layer = "counts"
        ) %>%
        rowSums()

    sobj$tumor_cell <-
        if_else(
            sobj$tumor_marker_count > 0,
            TRUE,
            FALSE
        )
}



DimPlot(
    stuff,
    group.by = "has_barcode"
)
```
